subject: Concession request: Medimatrix ask for 30% off Hosted API committed plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@medimatrix.com>
Cc: procurement@medimatrix.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commercial — next steps and volume bands

Alex — great to meet last week. Appreciate the clear signal from your product team about where Redwood can move the needle on query latency and cost. Per our conversation, summary of the commercial we discussed: 

- Pilot: 200k tokens/day for 3 months (no discount, standard hosted API pricing)
- Post-pilot: target production ramp to ~6M tokens/month by month 6
- Requested concession: Medimatrix asked for a lower unit rate if they commit to a 12-month term

I want to be transparent: discounts above 20% require senior approval. If you can confirm the committed monthly spend and whether you're open to a 6-month prepay, I can kick off an expedited approval request. Attached: SOW draft and procurement form for your legal/procurement teams.

Next step: can you confirm the expected steady-state monthly commit (range is fine) and whether prepay is an option?

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: Medimatrix_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@medimatrix.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medimatrix.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial — next steps and volume bands

Vivek — thanks for the recap. We ran the numbers with finance/procurement. Two asks from our side before we can sign: 

1) Price: we need a 30% reduction on hosted API list rates once we move to production (post-pilot). That is a hard threshold for central procurement to justify platform standardization.
2) Terms: we need a standard SLA for latency and a clause on data residency (US only).

We can commit to a 12-month term at an expected steady-state of 6M tokens/month and are prepared to prepay 6 months if required. Procurement attached the completed procurement form (see attached). If Redwood can meet the pricing and residency requirement, we can fast-track legal and procurement.

—Alex
Alex Martin
Head of Product, Medimatrix
attachments: Medimatrix_Procurement_Form.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Medimatrix procurement + ask for 30% off — need senior signoff

Team — forwarding Alex's note and procurement form. Medimatrix is a strategic target (large payer with strong references in mid-market healthtech). They're asking for 30% off list for a 12-month committed plan (6M tokens/mo) and are open to 6-month prepay. They also want US residency + latency SLA.

Why I recommend we approve a concession (but not full 30%): 
- Economics: at 6M tokens/month a 25% discount still preserves attractive unit economics if we require a 12-month commit + 6-month prepay.
- Risk controls: limit concession to hosted API (no Dedicated or Private), restrict to selected model family, and include a termination for material quality regressions.
- Upside: referenceable healthtech customer with potential upsell to Dedicated in 12–18 months.

Proposal for approval request to execs: approve up to 25% off list (final signoff), contingent on:
  * 12-month firm commit at 6M tokens/month minimum
  * 6-month prepayment (applied first to invoices)
  * Legal to sign off on SLA + data residency language; Redwood legal to include a clause limiting broader concessions elsewhere

Attachments: Medimatrix_Procurement_Form.pdf, Medimatrix_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Terms_Deviations.docx

Please advise if you want to escalate to Marissa for a final sign. If approved, I will update commercial terms and send to Alex and procurement.

Thanks,
Vivek
attachments referenced

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medimatrix procurement + ask for 30% off — need senior signoff

Vivek / Ben / Lauren — reviewed the economics and legal caveats. Approve a one-time concession up to 25% off hosted API list price under the conditions you outlined. Please make sure the following are enforced before commercial execution:

1) Contract must include a 12-month minimum commitment at 6M tokens/month with a liquidated damages schedule if minimums are not met.
2) Finance must receive 6 months prepayment in cleared funds before the first production invoice is generated.
3) Legal to finalize an addendum limiting the concession to the named account and model family; no precedentable catalog changes.
4) SLA and US-only data residency language must be accepted by Legal and Tech Ops; if Tech Ops flags an unresolvable issue, retract approval.

Once Ben confirms finance has received prepayments and Legal signs the addendum, Vivek you can send the signed SOW and a commercial summary to Alex and procurement and proceed to DocuSign.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Terms_Deviations.docx
notes: Internal approval granted at 25% with conditions; customer initially asked for 30%
